items.title: Paul Beaulieu Interview, 1960-06-11
items.q: He wasn't an old man Lorenzo's only son.

ctx.x: We called him Lanky, young teal. We called him Lanky. But he wasn't there. He wasn't an old man Lorenzo's only son. He had brothers and sisters. Maybe some more. They may be still over there in Basinless or Pasquale, whatever place you lived in Mississippi. They may be still there. Or even over here.
I believe there's one relative somebody told me about.
